items.name: glyph
items.title: Glyph
items.description: YoRHa dot glyphs: bitmap marks drawn as merged integer rects (crispEdges, currentColor), boxes 12/16/20, integer scale 1/2. One geometry source for icons, diamonds, markers and arrows.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. Glyphs are decorative (aria-hidden); label the control, not the glyph. Scale with `scale={2}`, never a CSS transform.
